# Together we're better

Inspire is the world's largest health community.

**Find the support you need**
in a space built for you

# Built for connection, not clicks

Inspire brings together patients and caregivers who know what it’s like to live with a health
condition. It’s a place to share experiences, ask questions, and find real connection with people
who understand. Here, personal stories meet trusted information to help you feel more informed and
confident. You can engage on your own terms—openly or anonymously—in a space built for honest,
judgment-free conversation. Every voice helps someone else feel less alone, and together, members
create a community that drives awareness, understanding, and change.
Join now for free
[image]

# Stay connected wherever you are

The Inspire app makes it easy to keep up with your communities, share updates, and find support when
you need it most. Available on both iOS and Android

[image]

# Communities for every health journey

Explore hundreds of patient and caregiver communities. They cover everything from rare and chronic
conditions to genetic, oncology, autoimmune, mental health, and everything in between. Each
community is shaped by real people sharing lived experiences, and offering encouragement.
* [Advanced Breast Cancer][8]
* [Lung Cancer][9]
* [Crohn's Disease & Ulcerative Colitis][10]
* [Ovarian Cancer][11]
* [Lupus][12]
* [Scleroderma Foundation][13]
* [Psoriasis][14]
* [Rare & Genetic Disorders][15]
* [Autoimmune Disease][16]
* [Bone Health & Osteoporosis][17]
Search our communities
[image]

# Partnering to strengthen every patient community

Inspire collaborates with leading advocacy organizations to extend their reach and bring trusted
resources directly to our shared members. Together, we create spaces that amplify patient voices,
foster connection, and drive meaningful change.
Become a partner

# Accelerate life-changing discoveries

Inspire is vital to those striving to develop better treatments, improve care, and deliver stronger
outcomes for patients. By engaging millions of patients and caregivers across thousands of health
conditions, Inspire helps sponsors better understand real-world experiences, raise awareness, and
accelerate the path from discovery to delivery.
Work with us

## Make the connection to PageOne's award winning messaging gateway

Mobile-enable your applications by connecting to PageOne's Oventus messaging gateway: whether its
bulk SMS, multi-channel mass broadcasts, custom voice-messaging or even geo-location services,
Oventus is your gateway to empowering your systems and services.

With a range of documented API's, PageOne make it easy for you. To find the right API for you and to
get started [click here][5].

## Find the perfect API for your application
* Web / Application APIs
  
  ## Web / Application APIs
  * ### SOAP/XML
    
    Our most powerful integration option for developers wanting to build messaging into their
    applications. For fast, secure, 2-way messaging to pagers, 2-way pagers and mobiles. Also
    supports voice and geolocation services.
    
    [Learn more >>][6]
  * ### HTTP/REST
    
    If you are building messaging into a web application, our RESTful API will provide secure, 2-way
    messaging to mobiles, using standard post and get requests.
    
    [Learn more >>][7]
  * ### FTP (SCP)
    
    A secure and easy to use protocol that is also universally accepted. Using SCP, this protocol
    provides reliable access for sending pager and SMS via the Oventus messaging gateway.
    
    [Learn more >>][8]
* Specialist Protocols
  
  ## Specialist Protocols
  * ### TAP
    
    TAP uses a modem to modem connection to provide delivery of SMS & Paging messages. It is very
    easy to set up.
    
    [Learn more >>][9]
  * ### SMPP
    
    SMPP is a binary protocol that can be used by clients to connect to the PageOne SMSC. It is only
    recommended for customers with SMPP experience or who have services/applications that are
    already SMPP enabled.
    
    [Learn more >>][10]
  * ### SNPP
    
    SNPP offers organisations a simple yet reliable way to send both paging and SMS messages via an
    existing internet connection.
    
    [Learn more >>][11]
* Desktop Application
  
  ## Desktop Applications
  * ### Excel Plugin
    
    Our Excel plugin enables you to send text messages direct from your Excel worksheets, ideal if
    you need to extract large volumes of contacts from within worksheets.
    
    [Learn more >>][12]
  * ### Outlook SMS Service
    
    Our Excel pluginenables you to send text messages direct from your Excel worksheets, ideal if
    you need to extract large volumes of contacts from within worksheets.
    
    [Learn more >>][13]
  * ### SMTP (email)
    
    SMTP is the simplest way of sending & receiving pager and mobile messages. Simply configure your
    server or existing email clients.
    
    [Learn more >>][14]

## Therapie von obstruktiver Schlafapnoe mit Schienen von SomnoMed^{®}

Schnarchen und obstruktive Schlafapnoe (OSA) können dadurch verursacht werden, dass sich die
Atemwege im hinteren Teil Ihres Rachens während des Schlafs verengen.
Unterkieferprotrusions-Schienen, wie unsere SomnoDent Avant^{®}, bewegen Kiefer und Zunge nach
vorne, um so während des Schlafs die Atemwege offen zu halten.

[ Mehr erfahren ][55]

## Weltweit führend bei der Behandlung von OSA mit Unterkiefer-protrusionsschienen

SomnoMed ist der weltweit größte Anbieter von Schlafapnoe-Schienen und in 28 Ländern vertreten. Seit
2004 haben wir mehr als 1.000.000 Patienten zu einem komfortablen Schlaf verholfen und ihre
obstruktive Schlafapnoe (OSA) effektiv behandelt.
Wir fertigen Ihre Schlafapnoe-Schiene nach denselben Qualitätsstandards für medizinische Geräte, die
auch für Herzschrittmacher verwendet werden, und stellen sicher, dass Ihre Schiene für Ihre erste
Nacht – und jede weitere Nacht – komfortabel ist.

Verglichen mit dem Tragen einer CPAP-Maske bietet eine SomnoDent Avant höchsten Komfort. Das spüren
Sie vom ersten Moment an, wenn Sie die Schiene in den Mund nehmen und diese sanft auf Ihre Zähne
gleitet. Lesen Sie, wie unsere b-flex Comfort Liner^{®} Innenschicht unvergleichlichen Komfort und
Passgenauigkeit bietet.

## Über eine Million Leben verändert

Seit 2004 hat SomnoMed über eine Million Mundvorrichtungen an Patienten in 28 Ländern geliefert –
über eine Million Menschen schlafen nun bequem und Familien genießen ruhige Nächte.

Unsere Zusammenarbeit mit Schlafmedizinern hat gezeigt, dass die Therapie mit Mundvorrichtungen eine
wirksame Alternative zur CPAP-Therapie ist. Mit einer durchschnittlichen Nutzungsdauer von** 6,9
Stunden pro Nacht¹ und einer Verbesserung der Schlafqualität bei 91 % der Patientent^{2,}** die
unsere SomnoDent Avant verwenden, könnte die Therapie mit Mundvorrichtungen die bevorzugte Wahl für
Sie sein, um sich von den Einschränkungen der CPAP-Therapie zu befreien.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

PRACTICE AREAS

Are you concerned about regulatory gaps in your current state licensing program? 

Does your company risk facing business interruptions because you need to show proof of state
licensure to manufacture, distribute, or sell a drug or device?  

Are you looking for cost-effective options for managing your current state licensing program?

Complete Compliance Solutions specializes in pharmaceutical state licensing services, ensuring your
business stays compliant and streamlined. Whether you deal with manufacturing or distributing
pharmaceuticals, our expert team is here to help you secure and manage the necessary licenses
efficiently.

 

By partnering with us, you can focus on growing your business while we handle the complexities of
regulatory compliance. Trust us to simplify your pharmaceutical licensing needs.

PRACTICE AREAS

## Our Pharma State Licensing Services

### OTC & Rx State Drug Manufacturing Licensing 

Drug manufacturing models include physical manufacturers, contract manufacturing organizations
(CMOs), and virtual manufacturers. State pharmaceutical licensing requirements depend on the unique
manufacturing model and drug product category (OTC vs Rx) .

Complete Compliance Solutions partners with OTC and Rx drug manufacturers to identify and secure
state licenses appropriate for their unique manufacturing model and manage license renewals.

[Learn More ][16]

### OTC & Rx State Drug Distribution Licensing 

Distribution models vary based on whether the company distributes their own pharmaceutical products,
distributes products manufactured by other companies, or distributes products under the direction of
a distributor or manufacturer. State agencies regulate distributors differently depending on their
unique distribution model and drug product category (OTC vs Rx).

Complete Compliance Solutions assists OTC and Rx drug distributors with identifying the appropriate
license type, securing required licenses, and managing license renewals. 

[Learn More ][17]

### OTC & Rx State Medical Device Manufacturer and Distributor Licensing 

Medical device manufacturers and distributors are regulated by state agencies based on their unique
business model and medical device category (OTC vs Rx). Device manufacturing models include
own-product manufacturers, contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), and virtual manufacturers.

Complete Compliance Solutions manages state licensing for OTC and Rx medical device manufacturing
and distribution companies. 

[Learn More ][18]

sell pharmaceuticals in the United States. And, each state regulates the supply chain differently.

regulation to determine necessary licenses. Once required licenses are identified, companies can be
overwhelmed by the complicated application process unique to every state.

dates and renewal requirements differing by state.

States regulate combinations of different product categories. Most states regulate the manufacturing
and distribution of Rx drugs and Rx medical devices in their state. While the regulation of Rx drugs
and medical devices by states is widely understood by pharmaceutical companies, companies may be
unaware that approximately 20 states regulate the manufacturing and distribution OTC drug and

## Better Sleep for Brighter Days.

Cryosa is a clinical stage company developing a treatment for moderate to severe Obstructive Sleep
Apnea (OSA). We believe that mask-free, hose-free, implant-free treatment is possible. Everyone is
free to sleep, free to rest and free to live brighter days.

### OSA Is a Big Problem.

MILLIONS OF PEOPLE are affected by OSA worldwide¹ and the current treatment options are suboptimal.
Many people cannot tolerate positive airway pressure therapies and alternatives require painful
surgeries or implants.

### But We Want To Change That.

## About Us

Experience + Success. Cryosa is led by an experienced team with deep roots in the medical device
industry. Our team is made up of successful startup entrepreneurs, engineers, and seasoned medical
device executives. Together, we’re paving a new way to treat obstructive sleep apnea.

# Embrace Being

# Free To Sleep.

Meet Cryosa. We are developing breakthrough, innovative technologies to treat obstructive sleep
apnea.

[Man and woman in nature]

## Better Sleep for Brighter Days.

Cryosa is a clinical stage company developing a treatment for moderate to severe Obstructive Sleep
Apnea (OSA). We believe that mask-free, hose-free, implant-free treatment is possible. Everyone is
free to sleep, free to rest and free to live brighter days.

### OSA Is a Big Problem.

MILLIONS OF PEOPLE are affected by OSA worldwide¹ and the current treatment options are suboptimal.
Many people cannot tolerate positive airway pressure therapies and alternatives require painful
surgeries or implants.

### But We Want To Change That.

## About Us

Experience + Success. Cryosa is led by an experienced team with deep roots in the medical device
industry. Our team is made up of successful startup entrepreneurs, engineers, and seasoned medical
device executives. Together, we’re paving a new way to treat obstructive sleep apnea.

## The Genio System

What is Genio Therapy? Battery-Free Stimulator Sleep Wearable Patient-Centric Smartphone App
[Genio Therapy Device]

### What is Genio Therapy?

Genio is an FDA-approved, mask-free treatment option for moderate to severe Obstructive Sleep Apnea
(OSA). Genio therapy works by gently stimulating hypoglossal nerves to contract muscles on both
sides of the tongue, keeping the airway open throughout the night. The Genio System features a
battery-free stimulator that’s externally powered by a sleep wearable, with customizable settings
available through a Smartphone app. Genio therapy has been clinically proven to significantly reduce
sleep-related breathing events, with high rates of daily use and patient satisfaction¹.

[Neurostimulator]

### Battery-Free Stimulator

Following eligibility assessment, a battery-free stimulator is inserted under the chin during a
one-time, single incision outpatient surgical procedure. The bilateral implant precisely targets key
nerves on both sides of the tongue to contract the tongue muscles and keep the airway open
throughout the night.

[Wearable]

### Sleep Wearable

The Genio System’s sleep wearable utilizes a disposable adhesive patch connected to an external
battery – also called an activation chip - worn comfortably under the chin. This wearable powers the
implanted stimulator, which together deliver gentle muscle stimulation on both sides of the tongue
while you sleep. The chip is charged daily via a small portable charger on your nightstand, in your
bathroom or wherever is most convenient, even during travel.

[App Control]

### Patient-Centric Smartphone App

The optional Genio smartphone app makes managing sleep apnea therapy easy. The app can be used to
quickly start, pause and adjust stimulation within pre-defined settings for maximum comfort. The app
also tracks device usage, providing valuable information to help you and your doctor discuss
progress.

## Aims to restore comfortable, restful nights for patients with sleep apnea

## ADAPTIVE THERAPY.
## PHYSIOLOGIC RESPONSE.

Designed for patients with moderate-to-severe sleep apnea, Lunair is developing an implantable
neurostimulation device and connected platform that aims to overcome current treatment limitations
and restore healthy sleep.
PHRENIC NERVE STIMULATION
The phrenic nerve activates the diaphragm and communicates with the brainstem to control
respiration. Phrenic nerve stimulation has a history of safe use for diverse indications, including
sleep apnea.
COORDINATED AIRWAY REFLEX
Phrenic nerve stimulation activates a coordinated upper airway reflex of respiratory muscles to
maintain an open airway during sleep.¹
RESPIRATION SENSING

Closed-loop system senses respiration and automatically adjusts stimulation to meet the patient’s
respiratory needs.

## Modius Spero is available to Veterans with PTSD through the VA

[ Learn more ][21]

# Noninvasive medical devices to treat some of the world's greatest health concerns.

Exclusively available to Veterans through the VA.
[ Get started ][22]
[ See the headset ][23]
[Girl wearing Modius Sleep headset and looking off-screen]
Your Health. Our Technology
Our mission is to Make Life Better. We understand that living with chronic health conditions can
greatly impact your daily life. Many medications and treatments come with side effects that can
prevent you from reaching your full potential and living the life you want.
 
Modius technology puts your health and wellbeing first, helping you live your best life.
Designed by Neurologists. Supported by science.

## Latest News

[

## FDA Grants World's First Neuromodulation Device to Treat Symptoms of PTSD

## The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has granted medical device approval to a breakthrough
## treatment that could transform the lives of veterans suffering from Post-Traumatic Stress
## Disorder (PTSD). The official FDA De Novo approval for Modius Spero makes it the world's first
## neuromodulation device to receive authorization by the FDA to treat symptoms associated with
## PTSD, a condition that affects an estimated 13 million Americans a year.

][24]
[

## Neurovalens granted EU and UK approval for innovative insomnia device

## Neurovalens, a global leader in non-invasive neuro-technology, has had its first product approved
## for sale in Europe and the UK after achieving EU Medical Device Regulation (MDR) compliance for
## Modius Sleep, it’s prescribed treatment for insomnia. It is among the first Northern
## Ireland-based companies to achieve EU MDR certification, placing it alongside some of the world's
## leading medical device manufacturers.

][25]
[

## Neurovalens at WHX Dubai 9–12 February 2026.

## Neurovalens is delighted to be joining the Association of British HealthTech Industries (ABHI) at
## WHX Dubai 2026, the Middle East’s flagship healthcare and life sciences event, taking place from
## 9–12 February 2026 at Expo City Dubai.

][26]
[

## Neurovalens secures £6m investment in funding round led by Investment Fund for Northern Ireland

## Neurovalens, a global leader in non-invasive neuro-technology, has announced the successful
## closure of a £6m investment round, led by the Investment Fund for Northern Ireland (IFNI).

][27]

## We are Nyxoah

Nyxoah is a medical technology company focused on the development and commercialization of
innovative solutions to treat OSA. Nyxoah’s lead solution is the Genio^{®} system, a
patient-centered, leadless and battery-free hypoglossal neurostimulation therapy for OSA, the
world’s most common sleep disordered breathing condition that is associated with increased mortality
risk and cardiovascular comorbidities.

[Learn more][9]
Image
[Genio professional implant ]

## What is Obstructive Sleep Apnea

Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is the most common sleep disordered breathing condition, affecting
globally around 936 million people between 30 and 69 years of age, of whom 425 million suffer from
moderate to severe OSA, requiring treatment*.

Left untreated, OSA is associated with increased mortality risk* and comorbidities, including
cardiovascular diseases, depression and stroke.

Clinical studies have shown that the mortality rate of non-treated patients suffering from OSA
increases significantly over time* . Untreated OSA is associated with a two-times more risk of
stroke* and five-times more risk of cardiovascular mortality*. OSA increases the risk of heart
failure by 140%*.

[Learn more about obstructive sleep apnea][10]

# Healthcare professionals

Inspire^{®} therapy may be a treatment option for your obstructive sleep apnea patients who are
unable to benefit from CPAP.

## What is Inspire therapy?

### Inspire therapy is a mask-free¹ solution for people with obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) who have
### tried and struggled with CPAP. Through a simple-to-use system including the Inspire^{® }implant,
### remote and app, Inspire therapy enables patients to breathe regularly so they can sleep soundly.

[Learn more][35]

## Many of your patients may be eligible for Inspire therapy

### The FDA-approved Inspire implant is used to treat OSA in CPAP intolerant patients. Learn more
### about indications and contraindications for Inspire therapy.

[View requirements][36]

## Commitment to quality

### At Inspire Medical Systems, Inc. our focus on successful patient outcomes is paramount in
### everything we do. Our Quality Policy is our formal commitment to you that we will never waver in
### that regard.
### 
### Inspire therapy Quality Policy:
* Relentlessly pursue safe, effective, and reliable treatment of obstructive sleep apnea.
* Strive to consistently improve the quality of life of our patients and exceed customer
  expectations.
* Maintain rigorous processes that ensure compliance with applicable global laws and regulations.

## “Put the patient first and you will never lose your way!”

### Every OSA patient experience is different, but one aspect rings true for all—it’s excruciating
### to live with. When it comes to OSA treatment, CPAP is the standard of care. While it works for
### many, it doesn’t always work for everyone. When this happens, patients feel like they’re out of
### options and out of luck.

From its original founding in 2007, successful patient outcomes and care experiences have been the
guiding tenants for Inspire. Dr. Glen Nelson, Inspire’s first chairman of the board, established the
motto, “if we put the patient first, we will never lose our way.” This spirit guides us and has led
to significant investment in the Inspire post market surveillance system. Putting the patient first
requires a deep understanding of the experience today and a continuous focus on identifying ways to
make the experience better all the time.

Dr. Glen D. Nelson
Inspire Chairman of the Board 2007-2016

Dubai Future Solutions – Prototypes for Humanity provides academic founders with funding, business
expertise, dedicated team support and closely managed industry collaborations to translate
scientific research into industry-aligned solutions — a journey that begins with technology
validation in real-world environments and evolves towards business set-up, commercial projects and
growth. Using a de-risking, commercially minded approach, it works hands-on with founders to develop
the foundations required to engage larger commercial partners and investors during and beyond the
programme.

The programme sits within Prototypes for Humanity wider ecosystem of initiatives that engages
thousands of academics every year, the largest and most comprehensive of its kind globally.

From research to pilot and commercialisation: the first cohort  

**Oxara – Sustainable construction materials**

Oxara transforms mineral and construction waste into low-CO₂ building materials using a fraction of
the energy and capex required by conventional cement production.

Founded by Dr. Gnanli Landrou and Dr.Thibault Demoulin, the company is now moving into
commercial-scale deployment following a successful pilot with one of Dubai’s leading concrete
manufacturers. At the same time, Oxara is accelerating its international expansion landmark projects
and strategic partnerships across Europe and Africa.

At scale, Oxara’s technology offers one of the most commercially viable pathways to decarbonise the
construction industry, while simultaneously reducing the financial and environmental burden of waste
management for developers, municipalities, and governments worldwide.

 

**P-Vita – Agricultural biotechnology**

P-Vita uses proprietary biotechnology and AI-driven production to produce natural, cost-effective
raw materials for the agriculture, food and pharmaceutical industries. Founded by Mohamed Tarek
Abdelzaher, an environmental engineer, and Naglaa Mohamed, Chief Science Officer specialising in
Biomedical Science and Molecular Biology, both graduates of Zewail City of Science and Technology,

## What is Sleep Apnea?

A large percentage of the population has a dangerous and sometimes fatal sleep disorder known as
sleep apnea. This condition is known as the silent killer.

This ongoing stimulation of the brain and the muscles of the upper airway prevents the body from
achieving the deep slumber it needs night after night. Patients may have severe daytime headaches
and lethargy for years before receiving the diagnosis and necessary therapy for their sleep apnea
because the condition doesn’t always fully awaken sufferers at night.

The hallmark of this issue is persistent, unconscious breathing pauses. These disruptions, or
so-called apneic episodes, can last anywhere from a few seconds to a few minutes and happen every
few minutes during sleep. Apneic occurrences put the body at risk because they cause the
bloodstream’s oxygen levels to drop while its carbon dioxide, or CO2, levels rise. The brain is then
prompted by this imbalance to open the airway fast, which results in loud snores and partial
awakening.

# Treat central sleep apnea without masks or medications

Living with central sleep apnea (CSA) can be exhausting. But with the **rem**edē^{®} System, you can
finally get the sleep you need to take back your days.

## Are you looking for relief from CSA? 

If you’re like many people living with central sleep apnea, you haven’t found a treatment that
works–or* lasts.*

That’s why we developed the **rem**edē System, the first FDA-approved non-mask therapy designed to
treat moderate to severe CSA in adults. 

**rem**edē is an implantable device that activates automatically and restores a more normal
breathing pattern, so you can sleep peacefully—and have more energy for what you love.

##### Learn more about CSA and rem**edē**

### Understand CSA

Central sleep apnea is a serious disorder that causes disrupted breathing during sleep. Know the
symptoms, causes, and how to find out if you have CSA.

[Learn About CSA][34]

### Discover rem**edē**

Learn about an FDA approved non-mask treatment for CSA.

[LEARN ABOUT rem**edē**][35]

### Getting rem**edē**

Understand the process of getting **rem**edē and find a doctor near you who can help determine if
you are a candidate.

[INTERESTED in rem**edē**?][36]
[testimonial video screenshot][testimonial video screenshot]

### Real people, real impact

Hear from **rem**edē patients who share their experiences living with CSA, how they got the
**rem**edē System, and how it’s improved their lives.

[WATCH PATIENT STORIES][37]
[Am I a candidate for rem**edē^{®}**?][38]

#### Important Safety Information

The **rem**edē^{®} System is indicated for moderate to severe Central Sleep Apnea in adult patients.

Your doctor will need to evaluate your condition to determine if the **rem**edē System is right for
you. The **rem**edē System is MR Conditional but conditions apply. Please make sure that your
physician knows about the conditions and precautions to ensure safety, which can be found in the
**rem**edē System MRI guidelines manual. You should not have the **rem**edē System implanted if you
have an infection and you will not be able to have diathermy (special heat therapies) after
implantation. The** rem**edē System may be used if you have another stimulation device such as a
heart pacemaker or defibrillator; special testing will be needed to ensure the devices are not
interacting.

As with any surgically implanted device, there are risks related to the surgical procedure itself
which may include, but are not limited to, pain, swelling, and infection.

Once the therapy is turned on, some patients may experience discomfort from stimulation and/or from
the presence of the device. The majority of these events are resolved either on their own or by
adjusting the therapy settings. The **rem**edē System may not work for everyone. There are
additional risks associated with removing your system. If you and your doctor decide to remove the
system, another surgery will be required.

Be sure to talk with your doctor so that you thoroughly understand all of the risks and benefits
associated with the implantation of the **rem**edē System.

# Treat central sleep apnea without masks or medications

Living with central sleep apnea (CSA) can be exhausting. But with the **rem**edē^{®} System, you can
finally get the sleep you need to take back your days.

## Are you looking for relief from CSA? 

If you’re like many people living with central sleep apnea, you haven’t found a treatment that
works–or* lasts.*

That’s why we developed the **rem**edē System, the first FDA-approved non-mask therapy designed to
treat moderate to severe CSA in adults. 

**rem**edē is an implantable device that activates automatically and restores a more normal
breathing pattern, so you can sleep peacefully—and have more energy for what you love.

##### Learn more about CSA and rem**edē**

### Understand CSA

Central sleep apnea is a serious disorder that causes disrupted breathing during sleep. Know the
symptoms, causes, and how to find out if you have CSA.

[Learn About CSA][34]

you are a candidate.

### Real people, real impact

#### Important Safety Information

The **rem**edē^{®} System is indicated for moderate to severe Central Sleep Apnea in adult patients.

Your doctor will need to evaluate your condition to determine if the **rem**edē System is right for
you. The **rem**edē System is MR Conditional but conditions apply. Please make sure that your
physician knows about the conditions and precautions to ensure safety, which can be found in the
**rem**edē System MRI guidelines manual. You should not have the **rem**edē System implanted if you
have an infection and you will not be able to have diathermy (special heat therapies) after
implantation. The** rem**edē System may be used if you have another stimulation device such as a
heart pacemaker or defibrillator; special testing will be needed to ensure the devices are not
interacting.

As with any surgically implanted device, there are risks related to the surgical procedure itself
which may include, but are not limited to, pain, swelling, and infection.

Once the therapy is turned on, some patients may experience discomfort from stimulation and/or from
the presence of the device. The majority of these events are resolved either on their own or by
adjusting the therapy settings. The **rem**edē System may not work for everyone. There are
additional risks associated with removing your system. If you and your doctor decide to remove the
system, another surgery will be required.

Be sure to talk with your doctor so that you thoroughly understand all of the risks and benefits
associated with the implantation of the **rem**edē System.

## Millions of people suffer from sleep apnea every single night

#### We will not rest until they sleep peacefully

## Restera is a clinical-stage medical technology company developing a first-of-its-kind treatment
## for sleep apnea.

Restera has united a world-class team of clinicians, engineers, investors, and leading research
institutions with a shared mission: to deliver a transformative treatment for Obstructive Sleep
Apnea (OSA).

Restera’s Board of Directors brings deep operational, clinical, and financial expertise across the
medical technology and life sciences sectors. The company’s Scientific Advisory Board includes
leading experts from renowned institutions such as the University of Pennsylvania, Vanderbilt
University, Stanford University, Flinders University, and Monash University.

## Sleep Apnea is a Significant Global Problem

#### One Billion

Sleep apnea sufferers worldwide

**Current solutions are not working.** Continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) therapy accounts
for 85% of diagnosed sleep apnea patients, yet nearly half don’t comply with the therapy. The
devices are cumbersome, loud, uncomfortable and overall intrusive.

#### Eighty Percent

Remain undiagnosed

**When untreated, sleep apnea is linked to serious and costly conditions,** including drug-resistant
hypertension, obesity, congestive heart failure, type-2 diabetes, atrial fibrillation and more.

#### $150 Billion

Economic impact of sleep apnea in the US

**Untreated sleep apnea costs the U.S. approximately $150 billion annually**, due to the healthcare
costs associated with these untreated conditions, as well as loss of productivity, workplace
accidents and motor vehicle accidents.

## Restera is Working on a Transformative Solution

**A miniature device, placed through a needle in minutes, ****opens the airway for measurably
improved breathing.**

Our therapy leverages safe, well-established neurostimulation technology in a miniature implant. The
device is designed to be injected in a simple outpatient procedure, leaving no visible scars and
enabling patients to return to daily life with minimal disruption.

During sleep, the system improves breathing by providing stimulation to open the airway.

> “a level of flow restoration not yet seen with any other stimulation”

— Leading Sleep Doctor and Restera Advisor

**Our mission to improve sleep for millions with OSA is focused on ****three key areas of
innovation:**
* **Better Neural Targets:** Restera has pioneered novel neural targets including a new area of the
  Hypoglossal nerve (HGN) as well as the Ansa Cervicalis (AC) nerve. Early results indicate each of
  these targets provide significant therapeutic benefit.
* **Skip The Scalpel:** Restera is combining proven ultrasound guidance together with injection
  through a needle to minimize or eliminate the need for any incision.
* **Precision Placement:** Our patented, innovative tools and methods are designed to allow quick,
  accurate placement of the device in minutes in an outpatient setting.

## Millions of people suffer from sleep apnea every single night

#### We will not rest until they sleep peacefully

## Restera is a clinical-stage medical technology company developing a first-of-its-kind treatment
## for sleep apnea.

Restera has united a world-class team of clinicians, engineers, investors, and leading research
institutions with a shared mission: to deliver a transformative treatment for Obstructive Sleep
Apnea (OSA).

Restera’s Board of Directors brings deep operational, clinical, and financial expertise across the
medical technology and life sciences sectors. The company’s Scientific Advisory Board includes
leading experts from renowned institutions such as the University of Pennsylvania, Vanderbilt
University, Stanford University, Flinders University, and Monash University.

## Sleep Apnea is a Significant Global Problem

#### One Billion

Sleep apnea sufferers worldwide

**Current solutions are not working.** Continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) therapy accounts
for 85% of diagnosed sleep apnea patients, yet nearly half don’t comply with the therapy. The
devices are cumbersome, loud, uncomfortable and overall intrusive.

#### Eighty Percent

Remain undiagnosed

**When untreated, sleep apnea is linked to serious and costly conditions,** including drug-resistant
hypertension, obesity, congestive heart failure, type-2 diabetes, atrial fibrillation and more.

#### $150 Billion

Economic impact of sleep apnea in the US

**Untreated sleep apnea costs the U.S. approximately $150 billion annually**, due to the healthcare
costs associated with these untreated conditions, as well as loss of productivity, workplace
accidents and motor vehicle accidents.

## Restera is Working on a Transformative Solution

**A miniature device, placed through a needle in minutes, ****opens the airway for measurably
improved breathing.**

Our therapy leverages safe, well-established neurostimulation technology in a miniature implant. The
device is designed to be injected in a simple outpatient procedure, leaving no visible scars and
enabling patients to return to daily life with minimal disruption.

During sleep, the system improves breathing by providing stimulation to open the airway.

> “a level of flow restoration not yet seen with any other stimulation”

— Leading Sleep Doctor and Restera Advisor

**Our mission to improve sleep for millions with OSA is focused on ****three key areas of
innovation:**
* **Better Neural Targets:** Restera has pioneered novel neural targets including a new area of the
  Hypoglossal nerve (HGN) as well as the Ansa Cervicalis (AC) nerve. Early results indicate each of
  these targets provide significant therapeutic benefit.
* **Skip The Scalpel:** Restera is combining proven ultrasound guidance together with injection
  through a needle to minimize or eliminate the need for any incision.
* **Precision Placement:** Our patented, innovative tools and methods are designed to allow quick,
  accurate placement of the device in minutes in an outpatient setting.

## Company Overview

Established in the year 2003, SITCO, an International Business House, has proven expertise in
different verticals of Businesses including Manufacturing, Agricultural, Minerals and Chemicals,
Coir & Geo Textiles, Non Conservation Energy Systems and Business Consultation. We,SITCO is an ISO
9001: 2000, ISO 14001: 2005 accredited multi faceted organization headquartered in India. Our goal
is focused on enhancing the value of client investments by successfully catering to the changing
demands of our customers. Through well-defined processes, industry best practices, innovative
products and exceptional services, we assist our clients to grow their businesses in the highly
competitive business landscapes. SITCO is a member of FIEO (Federation of Indian Export
Organizations) and is registered with DGFT. Our operations are globally managed by our international
delivery centers at Mumbai and Kerala. We have access to the finest manufacturing houses in India
assuring the best quality products timely at affordable prices. SITCOs strong client base spans
across the Middle East, Africa, South East Asia, Far East, Russia and Central Europe. SITCO also
provides a complete range of services by leveraging our domain and expertise in the trade of a coco
products supplies(Coconut,coconutshell,Charcoal,CoirFiber,Coco peat,coco pots,Grow bags etc )

## Finally, Freedom from Your CPAP Mask

If you're struggling with CPAP—can't sleep with the mask, tired of the noise, or frustrated with
poor results—you're not alone.** Over 15 million Americans have tried and failed with CPAP
therapy.**

### What is Inspire Therapy?

Inspire is the only FDA-approved implantable treatment for obstructive sleep apnea. It works from
inside your body to deliver mild stimulation to key airway muscles, keeping your airway open during
sleep.
* **No mask, no hose, no machine** – Just sleep naturally
* **Works with your natural breathing** – Gentle stimulation only when needed
* **Simple remote control** – Turn on before bed, off when you wake

### Proven Results That Matter

## Why Patients Choose Inspire Over CPAP

We understand your CPAP frustrations. Here's how Inspire is different and why it might be the
solution you've been searching for.

### CPAP Challenges
* Mask discomfort and claustrophobia
* Hose tangles and air leaks
* Machine noise disrupting sleep
* Travel complications and bulky equipment
* Dry mouth and skin irritation
* Partner disturbance and intimacy issues

### Inspire Freedom
* Sleep naturally without a mask
* No equipment, hoses, or maintenance
* Silent operation for you and your partner
* Travel freely – no packing equipment
* Natural sleep position and movement
* Intimacy and relationship benefits

## Could Inspire Be Right for You?

Inspire therapy is specifically designed for people with moderate to severe obstructive sleep apnea
who cannot use or benefit from CPAP therapy.

### You may be a candidate if you:

Have moderate to severe sleep apnea (AHI 15-65)
Cannot tolerate or benefit from CPAP
Are 18 years or older
Have a BMI of 35 or less
Do not have complete concentric collapse at the soft palate
Are willing to use the device every night
**Important:** Only a qualified sleep specialist can determine if Inspire therapy is right for you.
Candidacy requires a comprehensive evaluation including sleep study results, medical history review,
and drug-induced sleep endoscopy (DISE) procedure.

### Important Safety Information

#### Inspire therapy is not recommended for patients with:
* •Cardiac pacemakers or other implanted electrical devices that may interfere with the Inspire
  system
* •Inability to operate the Inspire remote control or understand device instructions
* •Pregnancy (safety during pregnancy has not been established)
* •Active infection at the potential implant site
* •Central or mixed sleep apnea comprising more than 25% of total sleep apnea events
* •Complete concentric collapse of the soft palate (determined via drug-induced sleep endoscopy)

#### Risks and Considerations:
* •Surgical risks including bleeding, infection, pain, and potential nerve injury
* •Device malfunction may require additional surgery for replacement
* •Battery replacement required every 9-11 years through outpatient surgery

Individual results may vary. Efficacy data based on the STAR clinical trial (N=126 patients) with
specific inclusion criteria. Discuss all risks and benefits with your qualified sleep medicine
physician.

comprehensive* review of each? Over the years, I’ve been doing just that.

It all started with a journey to stop my own snoring which led me to create this blog and ultimately
review more than 30 different mouthguards.

First things first, if you don’t already know what a snoring mouthpiece is, the [information
below][13] should answer most of your questions. In short, it’s an oral appliance similar to an
athletic guard or dental guard but is designed to hold the jaw or tongue forward which tightens the
airway and stops snoring.

Do they work? *Without a doubt*.

Now that I have mentioned my top 3 choices, here’s a bit more information summarizing why each
mouthpiece was chosen.

## **SleepTight #1**


☆☆☆☆☆ 5.00 Star

[Read SleepTight Review][14]

While SleepTight is a brand that you may not have heard of, it’s simple and incredibly effective.

What makes the SleepTight stand out from the crowd is its simplicity, effectiveness, and value.
While other brands attempt to differentiate themselves by adding features such as tongue straps and
mandible adjustments, SleepTight has focused on delivering a product that fits properly and is
comfortable. This is one of the *most important* features to look for, as a properly fitted
mouthpiece is less likely to fall out at night. Losing a dental guard while asleep happens to be one
of the most common complaints among users.

SleepTight is able to achieve a closer, tighter fit because of its patented dual-laminate design. 
The outer trays are made from a stiff FDA approved thermoplastic material while the inner core is a
soft material that creates a better impression of the teeth as compared to other snoring
mouthpieces. Unlike most Snoring Mouthpiece that are sold, this one is *actually* **made in the
United States.**

There is one large front breathing hole, the largest opening that I have come across. This is a
necessity for those who tend to breathe through their mouth during sleep or cannot breathe through
their nose because of a cold or allergies.

Another reason why I have rated this product highly is that it’s a great value. The manufacturer of
Sleeptight has offered the readers of this blog a **BOGO deal**, which can not be found elsewhere.
In order to receive this offer, you must visit [this page][15] on the company’s website.

Also, SleepTight offers a 30-Day Trial for just $9.95. You are charged only $9.95 and can try the
SleepTight to ensure you are satisfied before the balance is charged.

Here are a few other reasons why SleepTight has earned a spot in second place:
* Made in the United States
* Designed by Dr. Michael Williams, member of the [American Academy of Sleep Medicine][16] who spent
  over 40 years in dentistry and is familiar with the application of oral appliances.
* It was [cleared by the FDA ][17]in 2014 as a class II medical device and is described as an
  intraoral device for snoring.

# Offering a unique delivery model to treating obstructive sleep apnea.

Clark O. Taylor B.A., D.D.S., M.D.

[ Learn More About Our Delivery Model ][49]
[Dr. Clark O. Taylor]

## Let us help you find a solution.

Do you snore? Wake up gasping for air?

You deserve a quality nights sleep. Take a few minutes to fill out our simple sleep apnea
questionnaire to see if you are at high or low risk of suffering from obstructive sleep apnea.

[ Find The Right Solution. Start Here. ][50]

## Watch our free webinar

Is sleep apnea surgery right for you?

Patient education is the most important step toward combating obstructive sleep apnea. Learn more
about your options including OSA surgery and our unique delivery model.

[ Watch Our Free Webinar Now ][51]

## Schedule a consultation

Ready to take the next step?

Our team is ready to discuss your options and create a personalized treatment plan. Take control of
your sleep health today.

[ Schedule a Consult Today ][52]

## Our Unique OSA Treatment Model

Founded on the well-documented success of bimaxillary advancement surgery for sleep apnea (also
known as maxillomandibular advancement), Surgical Sleep Solutions has developed a unique obstructive
sleep apnea treatment model for delivery that eliminates the majority of negatives commonly
associated with this procedure. Our model, which has a **success rate of 95 to 99 percent**, has not
been duplicated.

Dr. Clark O. Taylor has extensive training and experience in maxillofacial surgery and has performed
hundreds of bimaxillary advancement surgeries. His unique approach combines the latest surgical
techniques with comprehensive patient care to achieve outstanding results.

If you or someone you know suffers from obstructive sleep apnea and has been unable to tolerate CPAP
therapy, bimaxillary advancement surgery may be the solution you've been looking for.

[ Learn More About Our Treatment Model ][53]

## Understanding Obstructive Sleep Apnea

Let us help you understand your sleep disorder and your various treatment options.

[ Watch Our Sleep Apnea Webinar Now ][54]
[Sleep apnea surgery at Surgical Sleep Solutions]

# Together we're better

Inspire is the world's largest health community.

**Find the support you need**
in a space built for you

# Built for connection, not clicks

Inspire brings together patients and caregivers who know what it’s like to live with a health
condition. It’s a place to share experiences, ask questions, and find real connection with people
who understand. Here, personal stories meet trusted information to help you feel more informed and
confident. You can engage on your own terms—openly or anonymously—in a space built for honest,
judgment-free conversation. Every voice helps someone else feel less alone, and together, members
create a community that drives awareness, understanding, and change.
Join now for free
[image]

# Stay connected wherever you are

The Inspire app makes it easy to keep up with your communities, share updates, and find support when
you need it most. Available on both iOS and Android

[image]

# Communities for every health journey

Explore hundreds of patient and caregiver communities. They cover everything from rare and chronic
conditions to genetic, oncology, autoimmune, mental health, and everything in between. Each
community is shaped by real people sharing lived experiences, and offering encouragement.
* [Advanced Breast Cancer][8]

[image]

# Partnering to strengthen every patient community

Inspire collaborates with leading advocacy organizations to extend their reach and bring trusted
resources directly to our shared members. Together, we create spaces that amplify patient voices,
foster connection, and drive meaningful change.
Become a partner

# Accelerate life-changing discoveries

Inspire is vital to those striving to develop better treatments, improve care, and deliver stronger
outcomes for patients. By engaging millions of patients and caregivers across thousands of health
conditions, Inspire helps sponsors better understand real-world experiences, raise awareness, and
accelerate the path from discovery to delivery.

# Together we're better

Inspire is the world's largest health community.

**Find the support you need**
in a space built for you

# Built for connection, not clicks

Inspire brings together patients and caregivers who know what it’s like to live with a health
condition. It’s a place to share experiences, ask questions, and find real connection with people
who understand. Here, personal stories meet trusted information to help you feel more informed and
confident. You can engage on your own terms—openly or anonymously—in a space built for honest,
judgment-free conversation. Every voice helps someone else feel less alone, and together, members
create a community that drives awareness, understanding, and change.
Join now for free
[image]

# Stay connected wherever you are

The Inspire app makes it easy to keep up with your communities, share updates, and find support when
you need it most. Available on both iOS and Android

[image]

# Communities for every health journey

Explore hundreds of patient and caregiver communities. They cover everything from rare and chronic
conditions to genetic, oncology, autoimmune, mental health, and everything in between. Each
community is shaped by real people sharing lived experiences, and offering encouragement.
* [Advanced Breast Cancer][8]
* [Lung Cancer][9]
* [Crohn's Disease & Ulcerative Colitis][10]
* [Ovarian Cancer][11]
* [Lupus][12]
* [Scleroderma Foundation][13]
* [Psoriasis][14]
* [Rare & Genetic Disorders][15]
* [Autoimmune Disease][16]
* [Bone Health & Osteoporosis][17]
Search our communities
[image]

# Partnering to strengthen every patient community

Inspire collaborates with leading advocacy organizations to extend their reach and bring trusted
resources directly to our shared members. Together, we create spaces that amplify patient voices,
foster connection, and drive meaningful change.
Become a partner

# Accelerate life-changing discoveries

Inspire is vital to those striving to develop better treatments, improve care, and deliver stronger
outcomes for patients. By engaging millions of patients and caregivers across thousands of health
conditions, Inspire helps sponsors better understand real-world experiences, raise awareness, and
accelerate the path from discovery to delivery.

## Make the connection to PageOne's award winning messaging gateway

Mobile-enable your applications by connecting to PageOne's Oventus messaging gateway: whether its
bulk SMS, multi-channel mass broadcasts, custom voice-messaging or even geo-location services,
Oventus is your gateway to empowering your systems and services.

With a range of documented API's, PageOne make it easy for you. To find the right API for you and to
get started [click here][5].

## Find the perfect API for your application
* Web / Application APIs
  
  ## Web / Application APIs
  * ### SOAP/XML
    
    Our most powerful integration option for developers wanting to build messaging into their
    applications. For fast, secure, 2-way messaging to pagers, 2-way pagers and mobiles. Also
    supports voice and geolocation services.
    
    [Learn more >>][6]
  * ### HTTP/REST
    
    If you are building messaging into a web application, our RESTful API will provide secure, 2-way
    messaging to mobiles, using standard post and get requests.
    
    [Learn more >>][7]
  * ### FTP (SCP)
    
    A secure and easy to use protocol that is also universally accepted. Using SCP, this protocol
    provides reliable access for sending pager and SMS via the Oventus messaging gateway.
    
    [Learn more >>][8]
* Specialist Protocols
  
  ## Specialist Protocols
  * ### TAP
    
    TAP uses a modem to modem connection to provide delivery of SMS & Paging messages. It is very
    easy to set up.
    
    [Learn more >>][9]
  * ### SMPP
    
    SMPP is a binary protocol that can be used by clients to connect to the PageOne SMSC. It is only
    recommended for customers with SMPP experience or who have services/applications that are
    already SMPP enabled.
    
    [Learn more >>][10]
  * ### SNPP
    
    SNPP offers organisations a simple yet reliable way to send both paging and SMS messages via an
    existing internet connection.
    
    [Learn more >>][11]
* Desktop Application
  
  ## Desktop Applications
  * ### Excel Plugin
    
    Our Excel plugin enables you to send text messages direct from your Excel worksheets, ideal if
    you need to extract large volumes of contacts from within worksheets.
    
    [Learn more >>][12]
  * ### Outlook SMS Service
    
    Our Excel pluginenables you to send text messages direct from your Excel worksheets, ideal if
    you need to extract large volumes of contacts from within worksheets.
    
    [Learn more >>][13]
  * ### SMTP (email)
    
    SMTP is the simplest way of sending & receiving pager and mobile messages. Simply configure your
    server or existing email clients.
    
    [Learn more >>][14]

## Make the connection to PageOne's award winning messaging gateway

Mobile-enable your applications by connecting to PageOne's Oventus messaging gateway: whether its
bulk SMS, multi-channel mass broadcasts, custom voice-messaging or even geo-location services,
Oventus is your gateway to empowering your systems and services.

With a range of documented API's, PageOne make it easy for you. To find the right API for you and to
get started [click here][5].

## Find the perfect API for your application
* Web / Application APIs
  
  ## Web / Application APIs
  * ### SOAP/XML
    
    Our most powerful integration option for developers wanting to build messaging into their
    applications. For fast, secure, 2-way messaging to pagers, 2-way pagers and mobiles. Also
    supports voice and geolocation services.
    
    [Learn more >>][6]
  * ### HTTP/REST
    
    If you are building messaging into a web application, our RESTful API will provide secure, 2-way
    messaging to mobiles, using standard post and get requests.
    
    [Learn more >>][7]
  * ### FTP (SCP)
    
    A secure and easy to use protocol that is also universally accepted. Using SCP, this protocol
    provides reliable access for sending pager and SMS via the Oventus messaging gateway.
    
    [Learn more >>][8]
* Specialist Protocols
  
  ## Specialist Protocols
  * ### TAP
    
    TAP uses a modem to modem connection to provide delivery of SMS & Paging messages. It is very
    easy to set up.
    
    [Learn more >>][9]
  * ### SMPP
    
    SMPP is a binary protocol that can be used by clients to connect to the PageOne SMSC. It is only
    recommended for customers with SMPP experience or who have services/applications that are
    already SMPP enabled.
    
    [Learn more >>][10]
  * ### SNPP
    
    SNPP offers organisations a simple yet reliable way to send both paging and SMS messages via an
    existing internet connection.
    
    [Learn more >>][11]
* Desktop Application
  
  ## Desktop Applications
  * ### Excel Plugin
    
    Our Excel plugin enables you to send text messages direct from your Excel worksheets, ideal if
    you need to extract large volumes of contacts from within worksheets.
    
    [Learn more >>][12]
  * ### Outlook SMS Service
    
    Our Excel pluginenables you to send text messages direct from your Excel worksheets, ideal if
    you need to extract large volumes of contacts from within worksheets.
    
    [Learn more >>][13]
  * ### SMTP (email)
    
    SMTP is the simplest way of sending & receiving pager and mobile messages. Simply configure your
    server or existing email clients.
    
    [Learn more >>][14]

## Therapie von obstruktiver Schlafapnoe mit Schienen von SomnoMed^{®}

Schnarchen und obstruktive Schlafapnoe (OSA) können dadurch verursacht werden, dass sich die
Atemwege im hinteren Teil Ihres Rachens während des Schlafs verengen.
Unterkieferprotrusions-Schienen, wie unsere SomnoDent Avant^{®}, bewegen Kiefer und Zunge nach
vorne, um so während des Schlafs die Atemwege offen zu halten.

[ Mehr erfahren ][55]

## Weltweit führend bei der Behandlung von OSA mit Unterkiefer-protrusionsschienen

SomnoMed ist der weltweit größte Anbieter von Schlafapnoe-Schienen und in 28 Ländern vertreten. Seit

Are you concerned about regulatory gaps in your current state licensing program? 

Does your company risk facing business interruptions because you need to show proof of state
licensure to manufacture, distribute, or sell a drug or device?  

Are you looking for cost-effective options for managing your current state licensing program?

Complete Compliance Solutions specializes in pharmaceutical state licensing services, ensuring your
business stays compliant and streamlined. Whether you deal with manufacturing or distributing
pharmaceuticals, our expert team is here to help you secure and manage the necessary licenses
efficiently.

 

By partnering with us, you can focus on growing your business while we handle the complexities of
regulatory compliance. Trust us to simplify your pharmaceutical licensing needs.

PRACTICE AREAS

## Our Pharma State Licensing Services

### OTC & Rx State Drug Manufacturing Licensing 

Drug manufacturing models include physical manufacturers, contract manufacturing organizations
(CMOs), and virtual manufacturers. State pharmaceutical licensing requirements depend on the unique
manufacturing model and drug product category (OTC vs Rx) .

Complete Compliance Solutions partners with OTC and Rx drug manufacturers to identify and secure
state licenses appropriate for their unique manufacturing model and manage license renewals.

[Learn More ][16]

### OTC & Rx State Drug Distribution Licensing 

Distribution models vary based on whether the company distributes their own pharmaceutical products,
distributes products manufactured by other companies, or distributes products under the direction of
a distributor or manufacturer. State agencies regulate distributors differently depending on their
unique distribution model and drug product category (OTC vs Rx).

Complete Compliance Solutions assists OTC and Rx drug distributors with identifying the appropriate
license type, securing required licenses, and managing license renewals. 

[Learn More ][17]

### OTC & Rx State Medical Device Manufacturer and Distributor Licensing 

Medical device manufacturers and distributors are regulated by state agencies based on their unique
business model and medical device category (OTC vs Rx). Device manufacturing models include
own-product manufacturers, contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), and virtual manufacturers.

Complete Compliance Solutions manages state licensing for OTC and Rx medical device manufacturing
and distribution companies. 

[Learn More ][18]

## Each State Has Different Licensing Requirements
## 
## Partner with Complete Compliance Solutions to Ensure Your Business is Compliant

[687665.jpg]

Every state has the authority to regulate OTC and Rx drugs and medical devices in their state. 
Unlike a single pharmaceutical establishment registration required by the Food and Drug
Administration (FDA), several state licenses may be required to legally manufacture, distribute, and
sell pharmaceuticals in the United States. And, each state regulates the supply chain differently.


The challenge facing pharma companies is matching their unique business model to each state
regulation to determine necessary licenses. Once required licenses are identified, companies can be
overwhelmed by the complicated application process unique to every state. 

 

Compliance does not end when licenses are issued.  Each license requires renewal, with expiration
dates and renewal requirements differing by state.

 

And, state licensing regulations change. These changes can be difficult to locate and stakeholders
are often unaware of changes.

## Our Pharma State Licensing Services

### OTC & Rx State Drug Manufacturing Licensing 

Drug manufacturing models include physical manufacturers, contract manufacturing organizations
(CMOs), and virtual manufacturers. State pharmaceutical licensing requirements depend on the unique
manufacturing model and drug product category (OTC vs Rx) .

Complete Compliance Solutions partners with OTC and Rx drug manufacturers to identify and secure
state licenses appropriate for their unique manufacturing model and manage license renewals.

[Learn More ][16]

### OTC & Rx State Drug Distribution Licensing 

Distribution models vary based on whether the company distributes their own pharmaceutical products,
distributes products manufactured by other companies, or distributes products under the direction of
a distributor or manufacturer. State agencies regulate distributors differently depending on their
unique distribution model and drug product category (OTC vs Rx).

Complete Compliance Solutions assists OTC and Rx drug distributors with identifying the appropriate
license type, securing required licenses, and managing license renewals. 

[Learn More ][17]

### OTC & Rx State Medical Device Manufacturer and Distributor Licensing 

Medical device manufacturers and distributors are regulated by state agencies based on their unique
business model and medical device category (OTC vs Rx). Device manufacturing models include
own-product manufacturers, contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), and virtual manufacturers.

Complete Compliance Solutions manages state licensing for OTC and Rx medical device manufacturing
and distribution companies. 

[Learn More ][18]

## Each State Has Different Licensing Requirements
## 
## Partner with Complete Compliance Solutions to Ensure Your Business is Compliant

[687665.jpg]

Every state has the authority to regulate OTC and Rx drugs and medical devices in their state. 
Unlike a single pharmaceutical establishment registration required by the Food and Drug
Administration (FDA), several state licenses may be required to legally manufacture, distribute, and
sell pharmaceuticals in the United States. And, each state regulates the supply chain differently.


The challenge facing pharma companies is matching their unique business model to each state
regulation to determine necessary licenses. Once required licenses are identified, companies can be
overwhelmed by the complicated application process unique to every state. 

 

Compliance does not end when licenses are issued.  Each license requires renewal, with expiration
dates and renewal requirements differing by state.

 

And, state licensing regulations change. These changes can be difficult to locate and stakeholders
are often unaware of changes.

## Are Your Products Regulated by State Licensure?

[Vitamins and pills]

States regulate combinations of different product categories. Most states regulate the manufacturing
and distribution of Rx drugs and Rx medical devices in their state. While the regulation of Rx drugs
and medical devices by states is widely understood by pharmaceutical companies, companies may be
unaware that approximately 20 states regulate the manufacturing and distribution OTC drug and
medical device products in their state. 


To add to the confusion, states regulate differently based on the distribution model (manufacturer,
virtual manufacturer, contract manufacturing organization (CMO), wholesale distributor, third party
logistics provider (3PL). 


In some cases, state licenses may be required even if the manufacturer or wholesale distributor is
not located in the state where the product is sold.

## Better Sleep for Brighter Days.

Cryosa is a clinical stage company developing a treatment for moderate to severe Obstructive Sleep
Apnea (OSA). We believe that mask-free, hose-free, implant-free treatment is possible. Everyone is
free to sleep, free to rest and free to live brighter days.

### OSA Is a Big Problem.

MILLIONS OF PEOPLE are affected by OSA worldwide¹ and the current treatment options are suboptimal.
Many people cannot tolerate positive airway pressure therapies and alternatives require painful
surgeries or implants.

### But We Want To Change That.

## About Us

Experience + Success. Cryosa is led by an experienced team with deep roots in the medical device
industry. Our team is made up of successful startup entrepreneurs, engineers, and seasoned medical
device executives. Together, we’re paving a new way to treat obstructive sleep apnea.

# Embrace Being

# Free To Sleep.

Meet Cryosa. We are developing breakthrough, innovative technologies to treat obstructive sleep
apnea.

[Man and woman in nature]

## Better Sleep for Brighter Days.

Cryosa is a clinical stage company developing a treatment for moderate to severe Obstructive Sleep
Apnea (OSA). We believe that mask-free, hose-free, implant-free treatment is possible. Everyone is
free to sleep, free to rest and free to live brighter days.

### OSA Is a Big Problem.

MILLIONS OF PEOPLE are affected by OSA worldwide¹ and the current treatment options are suboptimal.
Many people cannot tolerate positive airway pressure therapies and alternatives require painful
surgeries or implants.

### But We Want To Change That.

## About Us

Experience + Success. Cryosa is led by an experienced team with deep roots in the medical device
industry. Our team is made up of successful startup entrepreneurs, engineers, and seasoned medical
device executives. Together, we’re paving a new way to treat obstructive sleep apnea.

[Meet Our Team][8]

## Your Trusted Partner for Better Sleep Health

Our team works closely with you to understand your specific health concerns and match you with a
qualified specialist who can provide you with the care you need. From the initial consultation to
follow-up care, we handle everything to ensure that your journey to better health is stress-free. We
also assist in coordinating all the essential screenings and assessments, ensuring that every step
of your treatment is well-organized and timely. 

With the support of Dedicated Sleep, you can focus on what matters most—your health and
well-being—while we take care of the logistics. Trust our team to help you find the right provider
and guide you through the process with care and expertise. 

Initial Contact and Screening
The patient begins by completing a form on our website. Our Dedicated Sleep staff will then reach
out to screen the patient, gathering necessary information and assessing their needs.
*may vary depending on condition
Consultation and Sleep Study
The patient will have a telemedicine appointment with a medical doctor to discuss their symptoms and
potential sleep concerns. Following this, Dedicated Sleep will ship a sleep study device to the
patient for at-home testing.
*may vary depending on condition
Review Results and Plan Treatment
After completing the sleep study, the patient will have another telemedicine appointment with the
medical doctor to discuss the results and determine the appropriate treatment. If an oral device is
suitable, the patient will be referred to the closest dental office for further evaluation.
*may vary depending on condition
Therapy Setup and Device Delivery
If PAP therapy is recommended, the patient will be set up virtually with DS for ongoing treatment.
Alternatively, if an oral device is appropriate, the patient will receive impressions and later be
fitted with the device.
*may vary depending on condition
Follow-Up and Optimization
DS will continue to follow up with the patient to ensure that the treatment is effective and
optimized, providing support and adjustments as needed to achieve the best outcomes. This
step-by-step process ensures comprehensive care and support for patients throughout their treatment
journey.

## The Genio System

What is Genio Therapy? Battery-Free Stimulator Sleep Wearable Patient-Centric Smartphone App
[Genio Therapy Device]

### What is Genio Therapy?

Genio is an FDA-approved, mask-free treatment option for moderate to severe Obstructive Sleep Apnea
(OSA). Genio therapy works by gently stimulating hypoglossal nerves to contract muscles on both
sides of the tongue, keeping the airway open throughout the night. The Genio System features a
battery-free stimulator that’s externally powered by a sleep wearable, with customizable settings
available through a Smartphone app. Genio therapy has been clinically proven to significantly reduce
sleep-related breathing events, with high rates of daily use and patient satisfaction¹.

[Neurostimulator]

### Battery-Free Stimulator

Following eligibility assessment, a battery-free stimulator is inserted under the chin during a
one-time, single incision outpatient surgical procedure. The bilateral implant precisely targets key
nerves on both sides of the tongue to contract the tongue muscles and keep the airway open
throughout the night.

[Wearable]

### Sleep Wearable

The Genio System’s sleep wearable utilizes a disposable adhesive patch connected to an external
battery – also called an activation chip - worn comfortably under the chin. This wearable powers the
implanted stimulator, which together deliver gentle muscle stimulation on both sides of the tongue
while you sleep. The chip is charged daily via a small portable charger on your nightstand, in your
bathroom or wherever is most convenient, even during travel.

[App Control]

### Patient-Centric Smartphone App

The optional Genio smartphone app makes managing sleep apnea therapy easy. The app can be used to
quickly start, pause and adjust stimulation within pre-defined settings for maximum comfort. The app
also tracks device usage, providing valuable information to help you and your doctor discuss
progress.

## Smile…You’re Home at GPS Dental

Gentle, precise and sincere dental care for your family provided by GPS Dental in San Antonio.

Dr. Skrobanek is committed to providing complete, quality dental care and dentistry services in a
pleasant and caring environment for the entire family.

Dr. Gary Skrobanek is a native of San Antonio, TX. He attended Highlands High School, just a few
minutes from his office. When it was time to go to college and dental school, he remained in San

continuous excellence in clinical skills. He began private practice immediately, and joined a group
practice on the Southside of San Antonio in 1996 where he remained for 16 years.

## PHYSIOLOGIC RESPONSE.

Designed for patients with moderate-to-severe sleep apnea, Lunair is developing an implantable
neurostimulation device and connected platform that aims to overcome current treatment limitations
and restore healthy sleep.
PHRENIC NERVE STIMULATION
The phrenic nerve activates the diaphragm and communicates with the brainstem to control
respiration. Phrenic nerve stimulation has a history of safe use for diverse indications, including
sleep apnea.
COORDINATED AIRWAY REFLEX
Phrenic nerve stimulation activates a coordinated upper airway reflex of respiratory muscles to
maintain an open airway during sleep.¹
RESPIRATION SENSING

Closed-loop system senses respiration and automatically adjusts stimulation to meet the patient’s
respiratory needs.

Designed for patients with moderate-to-severe sleep apnea, Lunair is developing an implantable
neurostimulation device and connected platform that aims to overcome current treatment limitations
and restore healthy sleep.
PHRENIC NERVE STIMULATION
The phrenic nerve activates the diaphragm and communicates with the brainstem to control
respiration. Phrenic nerve stimulation has a history of safe use for diverse indications, including
sleep apnea.
COORDINATED AIRWAY REFLEX
Phrenic nerve stimulation activates a coordinated upper airway reflex of respiratory muscles to
maintain an open airway during sleep.¹
RESPIRATION SENSING

Closed-loop system senses respiration and automatically adjusts stimulation to meet the patient’s
respiratory needs.

Your Health. Our Technology
Our mission is to Make Life Better. We understand that living with chronic health conditions can
greatly impact your daily life. Many medications and treatments come with side effects that can
prevent you from reaching your full potential and living the life you want.
 
Modius technology puts your health and wellbeing first, helping you live your best life.
Designed by Neurologists. Supported by science.

## We are Nyxoah

Nyxoah is a medical technology company focused on the development and commercialization of
innovative solutions to treat OSA. Nyxoah’s lead solution is the Genio^{®} system, a
patient-centered, leadless and battery-free hypoglossal neurostimulation therapy for OSA, the
world’s most common sleep disordered breathing condition that is associated with increased mortality
risk and cardiovascular comorbidities.

[Learn more][9]
Image
[Genio professional implant ]

## What is Obstructive Sleep Apnea

Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is the most common sleep disordered breathing condition, affecting
globally around 936 million people between 30 and 69 years of age, of whom 425 million suffer from
moderate to severe OSA, requiring treatment*.

Left untreated, OSA is associated with increased mortality risk* and comorbidities, including
cardiovascular diseases, depression and stroke.

Clinical studies have shown that the mortality rate of non-treated patients suffering from OSA
increases significantly over time* . Untreated OSA is associated with a two-times more risk of
stroke* and five-times more risk of cardiovascular mortality*. OSA increases the risk of heart
failure by 140%*.

[Learn more about obstructive sleep apnea][10]

## We are Nyxoah

Nyxoah is a medical technology company focused on the development and commercialization of
innovative solutions to treat OSA. Nyxoah’s lead solution is the Genio^{®} system, a
patient-centered, leadless and battery-free hypoglossal neurostimulation therapy for OSA, the
world’s most common sleep disordered breathing condition that is associated with increased mortality
risk and cardiovascular comorbidities.

[Learn more][9]
Image
[Genio professional implant ]

## What is Obstructive Sleep Apnea

Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is the most common sleep disordered breathing condition, affecting
globally around 936 million people between 30 and 69 years of age, of whom 425 million suffer from
moderate to severe OSA, requiring treatment*.

Left untreated, OSA is associated with increased mortality risk* and comorbidities, including
cardiovascular diseases, depression and stroke.

Clinical studies have shown that the mortality rate of non-treated patients suffering from OSA
increases significantly over time* . Untreated OSA is associated with a two-times more risk of
stroke* and five-times more risk of cardiovascular mortality*. OSA increases the risk of heart
failure by 140%*.

[Learn more about obstructive sleep apnea][10]

# Healthcare professionals

Inspire^{®} therapy may be a treatment option for your obstructive sleep apnea patients who are
unable to benefit from CPAP.

## What is Inspire therapy?

### Inspire therapy is a mask-free¹ solution for people with obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) who have
### tried and struggled with CPAP. Through a simple-to-use system including the Inspire^{® }implant,
### remote and app, Inspire therapy enables patients to breathe regularly so they can sleep soundly.

[Learn more][35]

## Many of your patients may be eligible for Inspire therapy

### The FDA-approved Inspire implant is used to treat OSA in CPAP intolerant patients. Learn more
### about indications and contraindications for Inspire therapy.

[View requirements][36]

## How to add Inspire therapy into your practice

### It’s easy to get started—talk with an Inspire therapy expert and they’ll explain the training

[Learn More][22]

## What is Sleep Apnea?

A large percentage of the population has a dangerous and sometimes fatal sleep disorder known as
sleep apnea. This condition is known as the silent killer.

This ongoing stimulation of the brain and the muscles of the upper airway prevents the body from
achieving the deep slumber it needs night after night. Patients may have severe daytime headaches
and lethargy for years before receiving the diagnosis and necessary therapy for their sleep apnea
because the condition doesn’t always fully awaken sufferers at night.

The hallmark of this issue is persistent, unconscious breathing pauses. These disruptions, or
so-called apneic episodes, can last anywhere from a few seconds to a few minutes and happen every
few minutes during sleep. Apneic occurrences put the body at risk because they cause the
bloodstream’s oxygen levels to drop while its carbon dioxide, or CO2, levels rise. The brain is then
prompted by this imbalance to open the airway fast, which results in loud snores and partial
awakening.
